main_trends: TSMC March 2026 revenue reached 415.2 billion NTD (+45.2% YoY), driven by AI chip demand from hyperscalers including NVIDIA and Broadcom.
US-Taiwan chip deal commits $250B Taiwan investment in US manufacturing; TSMC Arizona scaling to $465B across 11 fabs with Taiwan tariff rate capped at 15%.
Strait of Hormuz closure since March 4 2026 threatens Taiwan energy supply (97% imported) and helium supply from Qatar, creating acute short-term production risk.
US imposes 50% tariff on Chinese semiconductor imports (effective Jan 2026) and new tariffs on Chinese chips announced for June 2027, reshaping global supply chain.
growth_drivers: AI accelerator demand from hyperscale cloud customers (NVIDIA, Broadcom) driving TSMC advanced node capacity constraints
US CHIPS Act and tariff framework incentivizing $250B+ Taiwan investment in American semiconductor fabs
Generative AI workload expansion accelerating enterprise adoption of high-performance computing
Advanced packaging (CoWoS, SoIC) demand growing faster than leading-edge wafer capacity
risks: Strait of Hormuz closure since March 2026 threatens Taiwan LNG supply (only 11-day reserves without imports), directly risking fab operations.
Helium prices doubled after Qatar Ras Laffan facility went offline; helium is critical for advanced node chip manufacturing.
TSMC Arizona fab costs 30% higher than Taiwan equivalent, compressing margins on US-mandated production.
US export controls on AI chips to China reduce addressable market; China retaliates with rare earth export restrictions (gallium, germanium, graphite).
Customer concentration risk: TSMC capacity at most advanced nodes increasingly limited, creating delivery risk for NVIDIA and Broadcom.
Geopolitical scenario planning required for cross-strait tension, US-China tariff escalation, and Middle East energy disruption simultaneously.
key_companies: TSMC (2330.TW) - foundry, 65%+ advanced node market share
MediaTek - IC design, AI chip exposure
Quanta / Wistron / Foxconn - AI server assembly
NVIDIA - key TSMC customer, AI GPU demand driver
Broadcom - advanced packaging customer, constrained TSMC capacity

Capacity allocation optimization: AI-assisted demand forecasting to manage constrained TSMC advanced node slots
Geopolitical risk early-warning system: track Strait of Hormuz, cross-strait tension, and export control policy changes
ESG and energy reporting platform: track Taiwan fab energy intensity, renewable energy ratio, and carbon footprint
